Definition: from G2596 and G4766; to strew down, i.e. (by implication) to prostrate (slay):--overthrow.
BiblicalUsage: With many of them God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wilderness is full of the overthrown, and the warning is written for me.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
